name: @core/base
summary: Core themes, animations, transitions, elements and scenes (16:9 first).
guide:
Core building blocks. Every other library builds on these.
TOKENS (use "$group.name" in any value, or {{$color.accent}} in expressions): color.bg bg2 surface fg muted accent accent2 accent3 line · font.display body mono · weight.display heading body · size.hero h1 h2 h3 body small label · space.margin xs s m l · radius.s m l · ease.in out inOut snap smooth spring bounce · dur.fast base slow · fx.glow
THEMES: core:dark (default) core:light core:neon core:editorial core:brutal — all take {accent}.
SCENES: title-card, statement, stat, quote, bullets, section, chart-bars, compare, split-media, logo-reveal, end-card, media-full. Scenes take exit:"fade" to fade out without a transition.
TRANSITIONS: crossfade, fade-through, slide-push{dir}, zoom-through, whip-pan{dir}, wipe{dir}, iris, flash, glitch-cut, bars.
ANIMATIONS for in/out/anim/loop: fade-in fade-out fade-up fade-down slide-in{from} slide-out{to} scale-in scale-out pop blur-in blur-out rise drop-in wipe-in{dir} wipe-out{dir} typewriter spin-in tracking-in grow-x grow-y draw glitch-in shake pulse float breathe ken-burns color-shift.
ELEMENTS: heading, kicker, paragraph, counter, pill, bullet-list, underline, progress-bar, lower-third, logo, quote-block, backdrop, cta-button, bar-chart, dots-field, image-frame.
TIPS: split text (split:"chars"|"words") makes in/out anims stagger per unit. Positions accept px, "50%", "10vw". Times accept seconds, "end", "end-0.5".
